# How values are determined

This reference lists every field with declaration-owned explanation metadata. The web and Apple explanation views use the same rules, value paths, source dependencies, and correction actions.

## Products (`product`)

### Manufacturer (`manufacturer`)

The current manufacturer and retained evidence supporting this value.

- Rule: `product.manufacturer`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Source dependencies: Stored manufacturer (`manufacturer`)

### Model (`model`)

The current model and retained evidence identifying the selected variant.

- Rule: `product.model`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Source dependencies: Stored model (`model`)

### Label evidence revision (`labelEvidenceRevision`)

The canonical revision of live label-purpose images, including image identity and content hashes or an explicit unknown-content revision. New evidence reopens label review.

- Rule: `product.label-evidence-revision`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `labelEvidenceRevision`; Summary `labelEvidenceRevision`

### Category (`categoryId`)

The current category and retained evidence supporting this classification.

- Rule: `product.category`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Source dependencies: Stored category (`categoryId`)

### Category family (`categoryFeature`)

Derived from category.

- Rule: `product.categoryFeature`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: Default `category.path[0].name`

### Valuation price (`price`)

A manual valuation price wins; otherwise Cubby derives a per-unit price from live priced expenses and their recorded quantities.

- Rule: `product.effective-valuation-price`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `fieldResolutions.price.value`; Detail `fieldResolutions.price.value`; Summary `fieldResolutions.price.value`
- Source dependencies: Manual valuation price (`fieldResolutions.price.storedValue`); Expense-derived unit price (`fieldResolutions.price.fallbackValue`); Selected price source (`fieldResolutions.price.source`); Incomplete expense coverage (`pricing.partial`)
- Available actions: Edit source

### External IDs (`externalIds`)

External IDs are the current live identifier records attached to this product, with their source and canonical display value preserved.

- Rule: `product.external-identifiers`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: Default `externalIds`
- Source dependencies: Product identifier records (`externalIds`)

### Primary GTIN (`primaryGtin`)

The primary barcode is selected from this product's normalized external identifiers.

- Rule: `product.primary-gtin`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: Default `primaryGtin`
- Source dependencies: Product identifiers (`externalIds`)
- Available actions: Edit source

### Images (`images`)

Product images are the current live Image attachments in canonical attachment order; list and summary surfaces use the same selected images through the display-image projection.

- Rule: `product.images`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `displayImages`; Detail `images`; Summary `displayImages`
- Source dependencies: Selected product images (`displayImages`)

### Unit price (`unitPrice`)

Comparable unit price converts one natural unit through the product's complete current conversion graph, including label or USDA-derived mappings and the effective price edge.

- Rule: `product.unit-price`, version 1
- Resolver: Product valuation
- Value paths: List `unitPrice`; Summary `unitPrice`
- Source dependencies: Effective product price (`pricing.effectivePrice`); Complete unit conversion graph (`unitPriceMappings`)

### USDA Food (`food`)

USDA food is the current lookup result for this product's explicit FDC identifier or normalized primary barcode.

- Rule: `product.usda-food`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `food`; Summary `food`
- Source dependencies: Explicit FDC identifier (`fdc_id`); Primary normalized barcode (`primaryGtin`)

### Model present (`modelPresence`)

Model present reports whether this product has a non-empty model value.

- Rule: `product.model-presence`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `modelPresence`; Summary `modelPresence`
- Source dependencies: Product model (`model`)

### UPC present (`upcPresence`)

UPC present reports whether the product has a primary normalized barcode.

- Rule: `product.upc-presence`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `upcPresence`; Summary `upcPresence`
- Source dependencies: Product identifiers (`externalIds`)

### Notes present (`notesPresence`)

Notes present reports whether this product has non-empty notes.

- Rule: `product.notes-presence`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `notesPresence`; Summary `notesPresence`
- Source dependencies: Product notes (`notes`)

### Expense total (`expenseTotal`)

Net basis is the sum of cost across this product's live expenses, including negative refund lines.

- Rule: `product.net-expense-basis`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `expenseTotal`; Summary `expenseTotal`
- Source dependencies: Live expense count (`expenseCount`)

### Component count (`componentCount`)

The component count is the number of live component relationships for this product.

- Rule: `product.component-count`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `componentCount`; Summary `componentCount`

In service counts live locations whose installed product is this product.

- Rule: `product.in-service-location-count`, version 1
- Resolver: Product quantity ledger
- Value paths: List `quantityLedger.locationCount`; Summary `quantityLedger.locationCount`
- Source dependencies: Installed location count (`quantityLedger.locationCount`)

### Ledger expected quantity (`ledgerExpectedQuantity`)

Expected quantity is the signed sum of product quantities on live expenses; incomplete quantity evidence is retained in the ledger status.

- Rule: `product.expected-quantity`, version 1

Derived from Product identifiers.

- Rule: `product.externalIdsLabel`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection

### Quantity variance (`quantityVariance`)

Variance is counted inventory minus expected expense-ledger quantity when both quantities are known.

- Rule: `product.quantity-variance`, version 1
- Resolver: Product quantity ledger
- Value paths: Default `quantityVariance`
- Source dependencies: Counted inventory units (`onHandUnits`); Expected ledger quantity (`quantityLedger.expectedQuantity`)

### Purchase date (`purchaseDate`)

Purchase date is the earliest acquisition date among this product's live positive-quantity expenses.

- Rule: `product.acquisition-date`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `purchaseDate`; Summary `purchaseDate`
- Source dependencies: Live expense count (`expenseCount`)

### Expense count (`expenseCount`)

Expense count is the number of live expenses linked to this product.

- Rule: `product.expense-count`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `expenseCount`; Summary `expenseCount`

### On hand units (`onHandUnits`)

On-hand units are the sum of live inventory quantities after applying each entry's unit mapping; unknown mappings make the result unavailable.

- Rule: `product.on-hand-units`, version 1
- Resolver: Product quantity ledger
- Value paths: Default `onHandUnits`
- Source dependencies: Live inventory entries (`inventoryEntry`)

## Expenses (`expense`)

### Spending category (`spendingCategoryId`)

An explicit Expense category wins over contextual defaults, Product Category mappings, and the stored Purchase fallback. Shared adjustments use the principal lines' category allocation.

- Rule: `expense.effective-spending-category`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `fieldResolutions.spendingCategoryId.value`; Detail `fieldResolutions.spendingCategoryId.value`; Summary `fieldResolutions.spendingCategoryId.value`
- Source dependencies: Source (`fieldResolutions.spendingCategoryId.sourceEntity`); Stored override (`fieldResolutions.spendingCategoryId.storedValue`); Inherited value (`fieldResolutions.spendingCategoryId.fallbackValue`)

### Cost type (`costType`)

An item line's cost type is its own. A tax, shipping, or fee line follows the items it was charged on, unless it names its own trade.

- Rule: `expense.effective-cost-type`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `fieldResolutions.costType.value`; Detail `fieldResolutions.costType.value`; Summary `fieldResolutions.costType.value`
- Source dependencies: Stored value (`fieldResolutions.costType.storedValue`)

### Trade (`trade`)

An expense trade override wins. Otherwise an item line uses its purchase default trade, then its effective project's default trade, and a tax, shipping, or fee line follows the items it was charged on.

- Rule: `expense.effective-trade`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `fieldResolutions.trade.value`; Detail `fieldResolutions.trade.value`; Summary `fieldResolutions.trade.value`
- Source dependencies: Source (`fieldResolutions.trade.sourceEntity`); Stored override (`fieldResolutions.trade.storedValue`); Inherited value (`fieldResolutions.trade.fallbackValue`)

### Project (`projectId`)

A principal expense project override wins; otherwise the expense uses its purchase's default project, then Household for food or Unassigned. Purchase-level adjustments are allocated across the purchase's principal project totals.

- Rule: `expense.effective-project`, version 1
- Resolver: Declared field projection
- Value paths: List `fieldResolutions.projectId.value`; Detail `fieldResolutions.projectId.value`; Summary `fieldResolutions.projectId.value`
- Source dependencies: Source (`fieldResolutions.projectId.sourceEntity`); Stored override (`fieldResolutions.projectId.storedValue`); Inherited value (`fieldResolutions.projectId.fallbackValue`)

Vendor is resolved from the live purchase linked to this expense.
